title: The Huawei Watch D3 is now available in Europe, comes with a free smart bathroom scale
description: While most smartwatches that purport to measure blood pressure use optical sensors, the Huawei Watch D3 is one of the few that does it right – it has an inflatable airbag cuff integrated into the watch strap and is CE MDR-certified for blood pressure monitoring. Starting today, you can buy one in Europe and you’ll get several freebies along the way too. You can use the Huawei Watch D3 to measure your blood pressure anywhere, anytime The Watch D3 is built for 24/7 blood pressure tracking. There is a new mode that runs measurements before and after you exercise. And even if you...

title: Motorola unveils Signature 27 with 200MP telephoto camera, Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6
description: Motorola has shared a first look at its upcoming Signature 27 flagship phone during Qualcomm’s Snapdragon Summit keynote. The handset is among the first smartphones to feature the newly announced Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. Although it is only the second phone in Motorola’s Signature series, the upcoming flagship introduces a new naming convention based on the last two digits of the year it is set to launch, hence the Signature 27. The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset in the Motorola Signature 27 is paired with an ArcticMesh cooling system featuring a vapor...

title: The 3D models of foldable phones on our site can now be opened and closed, here's a look
description: For many years now, we’ve been partnered with Binkies 3D to give you access to 3D models of smartphones that you can spin around, zoom in on and explore. But now foldable phones have complicated things a bit. These phones are designed to be used in two configurations – folded and unfolded. Each has its pros and cons and they differ by the form factor. A flip foldable’s cover display may be just enough to answer a quick text, but it’s not great for general use. Meanwhile, book-style foldables have cover displays that are almost as big as the displays on regular phones and tablet-sized...

title: Android OEMs pledge allegiance to the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series
description: The Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 are now official, and most of the big names in the Android sphere have already confirmed their next-gen devices with the new chips. Xiaomi is first in line with its 18 series. The 18 Pro will arrive with the standard 8 Elite Gen 6, while the 18 Pro Max will feature the Extreme version of the chip. Both phones will be introduced later today in China. Honor will feature the top-notch 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 in its Magic9 Pro Max, which is launching on September 28. The iQOO 16 and Pad Ultra are also set to use the Elite...

title: Oppo K14 Plus' key specs, launch date, and design revealed
description: Oppo teased the K14 Plus last week, and today it announced that the smartphone will be unveiled in India on September 29 at 12 PM local time. The Oppo K14 Plus will be available through Flipkart as a Flipkart Unique product, with Oppo promising "exciting offers during the Big Billion Days" to customers. A promo page set up on Flipkart reveals the Oppo K14 Plus will come with a MediaTek 7360 Max SoC, a 6.77" 1.5K AMOLED screen with a 144Hz refresh rate and 3,600 nits peak brightness, ColorOS 16, 8GB RAM, and 256GB storage. The Oppo K14 Plus will feature three cameras - one on...

title: Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and 8 Elite Gen 6 debut
description: Qualcomm’s latest flagship chipsets are now official. The new Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 mobile platforms are built on a 2nm process and feature Oryon CPU cores clocked at up to 5.0GHz. The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and 8 Elite Gen 6 feature 64 bit Oryon CPUs paired with new Adreno GPUs and Hexagon NPUs. Both chipsets feature two Prime cores clocked at up to 5.0GHz and six Performance cores running at up to 4.0GHz. They also come with 16MB of Oryon FlexCache and support up to 24GB of LPDDR5X/6 RAM at speeds of up to 5,300MHz, along with UFS...

title: Samsung Galaxy S27, S27+, S27 Pro, and S27 Ultra RAM and storage configurations leak
description: A few days ago, we heard that Samsung was considering using LPDDR5X memory in the Galaxy S27 and S27+ instead of going with LPDDR6. Today, a new rumor from Korea says the company still aims to equip the Galaxy S27 Ultra and S27 Pro with LPDDR6 RAM and UFS 5.1 storage, but there is a possibility that only one or more higher RAM/storage tiers would get that, while the lower ones wouldn't. On the other hand, it seems pretty clear that the S27 and S27+ won't see the new memory and storage standards. title: Beats 360 announced with interchangeable headband and cushions, and IPX4 rating
description: Beats today announced a new full-sized pair of wireless headphones, the Beats 360. These new headphones are targeted specifically at people who prefer using full-sized headphones in the gym and feature customizability and durability features, along with things borrowed from other Beats/Apple audio products. The Beats 360 are made from more hard-wearing materials and target long-term wearability. They feature an IPX4 water-resistance rating, a first for a pair of Beats headphones. The ear cushions ship by default in a Performance knit mesh material with foam padding but can...

title: Realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition hands-on
description: Realme teamed up with Warner Bros. Discovery Global Consumer Products last year for the Realme 15 Pro Game of Thrones Limited Edition smartphone. Earlier this week, the company unveiled two more limited-edition products in partnership with Warner Bros., inspired by the Harry Potter universe. The products that got the Harry Potter treatment are the Realme 16 Pro and the Realme Buds T500 Pro TWS earphones. We received the Realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition, so let's check what's on offer. Let's start by unboxing the Realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition's retail package, which is...

title: Samsung Galaxy A18 in for review
description: The Samsung Galaxy A18 is a simple phone that does the basics. It's limited to 4G networks, has a 5,000mAh battery with 25W charging, a 6.7-inch 90Hz AMOLED display, and runs Android 17 with Samsung's One UI 9 flavouring. In the hand, it feels okay. It's an almost 200-gram phone with a plastic frame and back panel, and comes in Black, Gray, and this Light Blue. Light is a very accurate term indeed - it's a very subtle color. There's a fingerprint scanner in the right-hand-placed power button, and it's accurate and works fine! The main camera is a 50MP unit with a reasonable...

title: Motorola expands the reach of its Qira AI with the Android 17 update
description: Motorola (and parent company Lenovo) announced Qira, their shared personal AI assistant, at CES. While Qira has been available on some Lenovo devices for a while, it's only now finally starting to make its way to more Motorola smartphones, following its initial introduction on the Edge 70 Max. It will be arriving on more handsets with the Android 17 update, the company has confirmed today. Qira will only be rolling out to phones in the Signature, Razr, and Edge series. title: The Signature 27 will be Motorola’s first smartphone with Bang & Olufsen audio
description: Motorola saw what Poco (and, before it, Redmi in China) did with Bose, and thought it wanted some of that co-branded audio action too. But it also stepped it up - all the way up to Bang & Olufsen's level. Motorola has entered into a multi-year partnership with the audio company, and as its teaser from yesterday showed us, the first smartphone to come with a B&O badge will be the Signature 27, which is expected to become official in just a few hours. title: RedMagic 12 Pro+ is coming next month, design teased
description: The RedMagic 11 Pro+ launched in October last year, and nubia has now started teasing its successor, the RedMagic 12 Pro+. The upcoming gaming flagship is confirmed to launch next month with a redesigned look. In a post on Weibo, nubia confirmed that the RedMagic 12 Pro+ will launch in October. The company has also revealed some of the design changes coming to the gaming smartphone. According to nubia, the RedMagic 12 Pro+ will offer an excellent in-hand feel. The phone will be lighter and slimmer than the RedMagic 11 Pro+ and feature rounded corners instead of the boxier design of...

title: Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 E are official too, here are their specs and pricing details
description: Alongside the Find X10 Pro Max, today Oppo has also unveiled the Find X10 and Find X10 E in China. These are more affordable options than the X10 Pro Max, as you may have expected from their names. Let's take them one by one. Find X10 The Oppo Find X10 has a 6.59-inch AMOLED screen with 1272x2768 resolution, a 144 Hz refresh rate (in some games, 120Hz system-wide), 288Hz touch sampling, and a 2,000-nit peak brightness. It's powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9600M chipset, which is a rebranded Dimensity 9500, built on a 3nm process (unlike the Dimensity 9600 Pro in the Find X10 Pro Max...

title: Nothing makes CMF an independent Indian brand
description: Nothing's more affordable CMF sub-brand is now turning into its own independent company, which will be majority Indian-owned, and will have its HQ and R&D in India. Nothing will stay on as a minority shareholder. Nothing's CEO Carl Pei thinks India will be the next country that will produce "its own global champions" in the tech space, following the likes of Japan, Korea, and China. The implication is that CMF will be one of the first such "global champions", since it will have "real R&D" in the country, which he describes as "the ability to design, engineer, and keep improving a product...

title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max launches with three 200MP rear cameras, Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC
description: Oppo has just unveiled its latest flagship smartphone, the Find X10 Pro Max. This is powered by the new MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, just like the vivo X500 Pro Max which was unveiled yesterday. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max one-ups its direct competitor in terms of cameras, though, sporting a whopping three 200MP sensors on the rear. The 24mm main camera uses a 1/1.3-inch type sensor with f/1.5 aperture and two-axis OIS, the 13mm ultrawide uses a 1/1.56-inch sensor, has f/2.2 aperture, autofocus, and an advertised 124-degree field of view, while the 70mm telephoto camera uses another...

title: Here's when the vivo X500 series is launching in Europe
description: vivo launched the X500, X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max in China yesterday, and today the company has already revealed when they're coming to Europe. The European launch event will take place on October 27, which is also when pre-orders will start. The devices will then be released on November 5. There is, however, something you need to know - while vivo's page talks about the "X500 series", the vanilla X500 is not shown. title: OnePlus N6 Lite goes official with a 7,000mAh battery
description: OnePlus has expanded its N6 lineup in India with the launch of the new OnePlus N6 Lite. The affordable 4G smartphone packs a 7,000mAh battery and joins the OnePlus N6 and N6x in the country. The OnePlus N6 Lite is priced at INR 16,999 for the sole 4GB RAM and 64GB storage variant. It is available in Midnight Black and a bright Neo Green colorway. It is powered by the Unisoc T7250 chipset and comes with a 6.75-inch LCD display that offers a 120Hz refresh rate and 900 nits in high-brightness mode. title: vivo X500 Ultra's China launch timeline revealed
description: After unveiling the X500 series in China, vivo will likely turn its focus to the X500 Ultra. While the company has remained tight-lipped about the phone, a vivo executive reportedly shared the launch timeline for the X300 Ultra successor during a media interview post the X500 series launch event. Huang Tao, Vice President of Product at vivo, reportedly confirmed that the vivo X500 Ultra will debut in China sometime in March or April 2027.
